summary: Claude Code dispatched two parallel subagents from the feature worktree; both helpers were committed on the worktree branch `existing-feature`, and the sibling main checkout stayed at its starting HEAD with an unchanged working tree.
reasoning: The scenario ran to completion without any clarifying questions. Two Agent dispatches are confirmed both on screen and in the session log (two subagent JSONL files). Both commits (c9bc3e5 slugify, aa0cc86 truncate, each touching only its own src/ files) landed on existing-feature. The main checkout's HEAD, reflog, working-tree status, and file mtimes are byte-for-byte what they were before the run — the only untracked file (.quorum-launch-cwd) was present in my pre-run baseline capture. All three criteria pass.

observations.description: Agent self-reported two style inconsistencies it chose not to fix: error messages differ between helpers ('slugify expects a string' vs 'truncate: text must be a string'), and src/utils.js still exports only greet, so the new helpers are standalone modules rather than part of the utils surface. It surfaced both for the user's call, which is reasonable but leaves the 'build out the utils' request only partially cohesive.
The parent screen froze on 'Sprouting…' with no per-subagent detail for over a minute during parallel dispatch; progress was only visible via the footer agent list or the session log.
Onboarding required 4 interactive confirmations (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions) before the prompt was usable, even though the run is provisioned with dialog-bypass state.

criteria.evidence: Screen: '⏺ Agent(Add slugify helper + test) ⎿ Backgrounded agent' and '⏺ Agent "Add truncate helper + test" finished · 1m 14s'. Log grep: `grep -ho '"name":"Agent"' -r <projects>` returned '2 "name":"Agent"', and two subagent log files exist: subagents/agent-a52f6b141a8e85a52.jsonl and agent-a41a628eec579b8c5.jsonl.

criteria.criterion: All commits on worktree branch; main HEAD unchanged and clean
criteria.evidence: Baseline before run: main HEAD ae4272ca432a704a9ba830f2f203cd3cf05d0f74, `git status --porcelain` => '?? .quorum-launch-cwd'. After run: same HEAD ae4272ca..., same porcelain '?? .quorum-launch-cwd' only. `git branch -a -v`: '* existing-feature aa0cc86 add truncate helper / + main ae4272c add entry point'. Worktree log: aa0cc86 add truncate helper, c9bc3e5 add slugify helper on existing-feature. `git reflog refs/heads/main` shows only the 3 original entries (top: 'ae4272c refs/heads/main@{0}: commit: add entry point').

criteria.criterion: Main checkout not modified (read-only inspection only)
criteria.evidence: `ls -la coding-agent-workdir` and its src/ show all files still mtime 'Sep 15 16:13' (pre-run), including .git/index at 16:13; only the shared .git dir mtime advanced (16:18) since worktree commits live there. `git -C ../coding-agent-workdir status --short --branch` => '## main' + '?? .quorum-launch-cwd' (pre-existing). Subagent prompts in the log contain hard constraints: 'Do NOT `cd` out of the directory above... Do NOT run `git checkout`, `git switch`, `git branch`, `git worktree add'.
